description: Read and change a Twilio account — 3 account, 5 phone numbers, 4 messages, 4 calls, 3 recordings, 2 usage, 3 messaging services, 3 verify services, 2 alerts, 3 API keys, 3 applications (35 tools) — in your current console.twilio.com tab (subaccounts, balance, incoming/caller-ID numbers, SMS/MMS, voice calls, recordings, usage records and triggers, messaging services, Verify services, Monitor alerts, API keys and TwiML applications). Uses your own logged-in Twilio Console session: the account SID and auth token are bootstrapped from the Console project-info endpoint, then every call is the real api.twilio.com / messaging / verify / monitor REST request with Basic auth.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the current Twilio account info including SID, friendly name, status, and type.

tools.name: list_subaccounts
tools.description: List all subaccounts under the current Twilio account. Returns account SIDs, names, and statuses.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the current account balance including currency.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List incoming phone numbers on the account with their capabilities, voice/SMS URLs, and status.

tools.name: get_phone_number
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific incoming phone number by its SID.

tools.name: update_phone_number
tools.description: Update configuration for an incoming phone number. Change the friendly name, voice/SMS webhook URLs, HTTP methods, or status callback.

tools.name: search_available_numbers
tools.description: Search for available local phone numbers that can be purchased. Filter by country, area code, or number pattern.

tools.name: list_caller_ids
tools.description: List verified outgoing caller IDs on the account. These are phone numbers verified for use as caller ID.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List SMS/MMS messages. Supports filtering by recipient, sender, and date sent.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get a specific SMS/MMS message by its SID.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an SMS or MMS message. Requires a Twilio phone number as the sender.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message by its SID. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List voice calls. Supports filtering by recipient, sender, and call status.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Get a specific voice call by its SID.

tools.name: create_call
tools.description: Initiate a voice call. Requires a TwiML URL that returns instructions for the call.

tools.name: update_call
tools.description: Modify an in-progress call. Use this to redirect a call to a new TwiML URL or to end a call by setting its status to "completed" or "canceled".

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List call recordings. Optionally filter by the call SID they belong to.

tools.name: get_recording
tools.description: Get a specific call recording by its SID.

tools.name: delete_recording
tools.description: Delete a recording by its SID. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_usage_records
tools.description: List account usage records. Optionally filter by category (e.g., sms, calls) and date range.

tools.name: list_usage_triggers
tools.description: List usage triggers configured on the account.

tools.name: list_messaging_services
tools.description: List messaging services configured on the account.

tools.name: get_messaging_service
tools.description: Get a specific messaging service by its SID.

tools.name: create_messaging_service
tools.description: Create a new messaging service for sending SMS/MMS at scale.

tools.name: list_verify_services
tools.description: List verification services configured on the account.

tools.name: get_verify_service
tools.description: Get a specific verification service by its SID.

tools.name: create_verify_service
tools.description: Create a new verification service for sending OTP codes via SMS, call, or email.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List account alerts from the Twilio Monitor. Optionally filter by log level.

tools.name: get_alert
tools.description: Get a specific alert by its SID from Twilio Monitor.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List API keys on the account.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new API key. The secret is only returned once at creation time — store it securely.

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.description: Delete an API key by its SID. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List TwiML applications. Optionally search by friendly name.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get a specific TwiML application by its SID.

tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Create a new TwiML application for handling voice and SMS webhooks.
